shortDescription: Tencent Music (1698) said its unaudited condensed consolidated interim results showed net profit fell 31.9% to RMB 4.562 billion, while revenue rose 11.5% to RMB 14.119 billion, according to Ming Pao.

title: Tencent Music Q2 Profit Falls 31.9% As Revenue Rises 11.5%
